invariants: A strategy title or symbolic pair is not a live market or an implementation.
Every amount requires fresh exact re-quote and coherent state.
No TVL-as-capacity; lender capacity and repayment must be proven.
Bridge/CEX/TON async and multi-period carry are not standard atomic flashloan legs.
Shared resources cannot be consumed twice across concurrent strategies.
Unknown remains null/blocked, never zero or synthetic success.
Models and correlations are advisory and cannot bypass evidence gates.
No sender, signer, wallet, transaction submission, live or production promotion.
